critical_code_review_comments: MissedBillNudge dismiss failure only toasts — no rollback if the row was optimistically hidden. Currently the setState happens AFTER the await so it's fine, but if the API is slow the user can double-click Dismiss; the button is disabled while busy so this is defended.

unbilled_recent_appointments query uses tenant-tz-aware day window but relies on the router-level tenant filter (current_tenant) — confirmed multi-tenant safe via the appointment fixture writes; nice.

Gift-card breakage backfill migration (lines 464-467 of gift_cards.py) runs on every deliver_scheduled_gift_cards call — cheap because it's `breakage_amount: {$exists: False}` guarded, but consider moving to a one-shot startup task.
